game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Eruption Watch, the volcano watchtower: the forge smith must handle ash wraiths while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Unit Trader: Convert units using expressions so each trade of ore chunks is fair.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Eruption Watch: the volcano watchtower
core_gameplay_loop: In Eruption Watch, repeat each round: Convert units using expressions so each trade of ore chunks is fair. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the fair_trades value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the lava bridge using at most 11 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The lava bridge reached with actions_used <= 11.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 11 before the lava bridge is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 2 (intro tier): Unit Trader
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Unit Trader' (Week 2 slot 14), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Eruption Watch'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how fair_trades changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ash wraiths in Eruption Watch.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The lava bridge reached with actions_used <= 11.
